items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Well the saxophone section was strictly Italian. It was Sal Nestico and Joe Romano and Carmen Leggio.

ctx.x: Well it’s good and bad I suppose because now there’s not as many venues for the big bands. Who else was on that herd at the time?
Well the saxophone section was strictly Italian. It was Sal Nestico and Joe Romano and Carmen Leggio.
